about_the_game:
Mazzy is a pixel-style casual puzzle game built around a simple but interesting idea: rotate and reshape the world.

In this game, you play as a stickman navigating strange mazes. Your goal is quite simple—reach the goal. However, in this world, the path is not always straightforward. You will be blocked when you try to find the correct path. By switching to Edit Mode, you can rotate the entire sections, shifting platforms, unlocking new perspectives, and revealing the new paths that weren’t noticed before!

Doors may block your way — or become part of the solution. You'll need to rotate with purpose, think spatially, and find clever ways to move forward.

Mazzy offers a relaxing and engaging experience. Rotate the level. Collect the items. Reach the goal. It’s that simple — and that fun.
